text:
<subject>Re: Rail Freight Policy Forum</subject>
<body>
Hi Jessica --

Emily is a Pilbara Rail Authority commissioner and we have invited two other Pilbara Rail Authority commissioners. Assuming one of her colleagues, Morgan Blackburn or Austin Huang accept, there is not a need to send an alternate. We appreciate the offer though.

Thanks, Michelle
</body>
<quoted>
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Maxwell, Jessica
Sent:	Monday, 22 July 2024 11:47 AM
To:	Gonzales, Michelle
Subject:	FW: Rail Freight Policy Forum

FYI...

 -----Original Message-----
From: 	"Fisher, Ellen" <ellen.fisher@altnorcorp.com>
Sent:	Monday, 22 July 2024 10:47 AM
To:	Richmond, Darren
Subject:	Rail Freight Policy Forum


Mr. Richmond,
Thank you for your kind invitation to participate in the interesting program that you are sponsoring in October. Unfortunately, I have a conflicting commitment and will be unable to attend. May I pass the information on to one of the other Commissioners here, or have you also invited others from our commission?
Thank you.
Ellen Fisher
</quoted>
